alt: Illustration: the Earth from low orbit at the day-night terminator, its surface divided into curved tiles outlined in thin cyan light that follow the coastlines.
prompt: A photoreal planet seen from low orbit at the day–night terminator: oceans, cloud bands, deserts and ice caps, lit by a low sun, a thin blue atmosphere glowing along the limb. The whole surface is subtly divided into large curved tiles that follow the terrain like the charts of an atlas, each tile edge a thin line of soft electric-cyan light, brightest on the night side where city lights glow. The tiles curve with coastlines and mountain ranges; they are not a latitude–longitude grid. Cinematic, calm, awe-inspiring, ultra-detailed, deep black space with a few stars. The planet fills the right two thirds of the frame; the left half and the lower third are dark and calm.
